plugins.name: File Sorter
plugins.description: Recursively scans a folder for FITS files and groups them in tabs by instrument. Non-science files (IMAGECAT other than SCIENCE) and files without a TCSTGT target go to their own per-instrument CALIB tabs. Friendlier column labels (TARGET, IMAGETYPE, OBSMODE, FASU A/B, GRISM, FIBER). Shows TELALT (1 decimal) and AIRMASS (2 decimals) for every file. A search bar filters all tables across every column (filtered tabs are marked with *). Select a range of rows to create a session-only AMPA sequence. Double-click a file to load it into the AMPA viewer.
plugins.author: samgrund

plugins.name: FIES Spectrum Viewer
plugins.description: Plots 1-D merged FIES echelle spectra (FIEStool products) with the wavelength axis calibrated from the FITS header (CRVAL1/CDELT1/CRPIX1, air Angstroms), trimming the noisy first and last 2% of the wavelength range. Shows OBJECT, fiber, exposure, VHELIO and airmass. The spectrum curve line width is user-adjustable (persisted). A checkbox overlays telluric absorption lines, colour-coded by absorber (O2 red, H2O blue) with a user-adjustable, persisted line width; hovering identifies each line (air/vacuum wavelength, molecule and band, indicative depth) and an optional Labels mode annotates the strongest features. The line table is derived from the DKIST Telluric Atlas (HITRAN2020/LBLRTM), stored in vacuum wavelengths and converted to air with the Morton (1991) dispersion relation to match the spectrograph scale; regenerate it with tools/generate_telluric_table.py in the repository.
plugins.author: samgrund
